create_OGNViz: create an ObjectGoalNavigationVisualization instance to visualize a single object goal navigation task with a goal name and output path
snapshot_OGNViz: take a snapshot of the current navigation state saving frames, maps, and metrics to disk
record_aggregate_metrics_OGNViz: record aggregate metrics including path length, number of steps, collisions, and all poses to a JSON file
update_semantic_frame_OGNViz: update and visualize the first-person semantic segmentation frame in the navigation visualization
update_semantic_map_OGNViz: update and visualize the top-down semantic map with obstacle, explored, visited, and goal regions
